sql.postalCode.getZones: select pcz.id, pcz.company_id, pcz.zone_name, pcz.distribution_time_frame_days, pcz.schedulable_future_days, pcz.archived from flow.postal_code_zone pcz where pcz.company_id = :companyId and pcz.archived is not true and case when :searchQuery::text is not null then lower(translate(pcz.zone_name, '*,.& ', '')) like '%' || lower(trim(translate(:searchQuery::text, '*,.&', ''))) || '%' OR pcz.id in (select pc.postal_code_zone_id from flow.postal_code pc where pc.archived is not true and pc.postal_code like '%' || :searchQuery::text || '%') OR pcz.id in (select distinct pczu.postal_code_zone_id from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow."user" u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.archived is not true AND lower(translate(coalesce(u.first_name, ''), '*,.& ', '')) || ' ' || lower(translate(coalesce(u.last_name, ''), '*,.& ', '')) like '%' || lower(trim(translate(:searchQuery::text, '*,.&', ''))) || '%') else 1=1 end order by zone_name
sql.postalCode.getZoneByPostalCode: select pcz.id, company_id, zone_name, distribution_time_frame_days, schedulable_future_days from flow.postal_code_zone pcz inner join flow.postal_code pc on pcz.id = pc.postal_code_zone_id where company_id = :companyId and pcz.archived is not true and pc.archived is not true and postal_code = :postalCode limit 1
sql.postalCode.getScheduleByUsers: select pczu.id, pczu.user_id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS "fullName", pczu.postal_code_zone_id as "postalCodeZoneId", pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id as "postalCodeZoneUserTypeId", pczu.archived from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow.user u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.postal_code_zone_id = :zoneId and pczu.archived is not true and pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id = 2 order by u.first_name, u.last_name
sql.postalCode.getCodesForZone: select pc.id, pc.postal_code as "postalCode", pc.postal_code_zone_id as "postalCodeZoneId", pc.archived from flow.postal_code pc where pc.postal_code_zone_id = :zoneId and pc.archived is not true order by pc.postal_code
sql.postalCode.saveManualUserAllocation: update flow.postal_code_zone_user set manual_allocation = :manualAllocation, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :pczuId
sql.postalCode.getZone: select pcz.id, pcz.company_id, pcz.distribution_time_frame_days, pcz.schedulable_future_days, pcz.zone_name, pcz.archived from flow.postal_code_zone pcz where pcz.id = :id
sql.postalCode.insertZone: insert into flow.postal_code_zone(company_id, zone_name, date_created, created_by_id, distribution_time_frame_days, schedulable_future_days) values (:companyId, :zoneName, now(), :createdById, :distributionTimeFrameDays, :schedulableFutureDays)
sql.postalCode.updateZone: update flow.postal_code_zone set zone_name = :zoneName, distribution_time_frame_days = :distributionTimeFrameDays, schedulable_future_days = :schedulableFutureDays, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.deleteZone: update flow.postal_code_zone set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.insertZoneUser: insert into flow.postal_code_zone_user(postal_code_zone_id, date_created, created_by_id, user_id, postal_code_zone_user_type_id) values (:postalCodeZoneId, now(), :createdById, :userId, :postalCodeZoneUserTypeId)
sql.postalCode.deleteZoneUser: update flow.postal_code_zone_user set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.getZoneUser: select pczu.id, pczu.postal_code_zone_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, pczu.user_id, pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id, pczu.archived from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow.user u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.id = :id
sql.postalCode.updateZoneCode: update flow.postal_code set archived = false, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :createdById, postal_code_zone_id = :postalCodeZoneId where id = :id
sql.postalCode.addZoneCode: insert into flow.postal_code(postal_code_zone_id, postal_code, date_created, created_by_id) values (:postalCodeZoneId, trim(:postalCode), now(), :createdById)
sql.postalCode.deleteZoneCode: update flow.postal_code set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.getZoneCode: select pc.id, pc.postal_code_zone_id, pc.postal_code, pc.archived from flow.postal_code pc where pc.id = :id
sql.postalCode.userCanSchedule: select pczu.* from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow.postal_code_zone pcz on pczu.postal_code_zone_id = pcz.id inner join flow.postal_code pc on pcz.id = pc.postal_code_zone_id where pczu.user_id = :userId and pczu.archived is not true and pcz.company_id = :companyId and pc.postal_code = :postalCode
sql.postalCode.getAvailableZoneUsers: select distinct upv.user_id as id, upv.first_name, upv.position_id, upv.last_name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS full_name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS title from flow.user_positions_vw upv where case when :isParent and :isSchedulingTool then upv.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else (upv.company_id = :companyId OR (:isSchedulingTool AND upv.company_id = :parentCompanyId AND upv.available_to_children is true )) end and case when :loadSchedulers is true then upv.position_scheduler is true else upv.position_schedulable is true end and upv.user_archived is not true and upv.archived is not true and upv.has_access = true and upv.company_id = :companyId and upv.start_date <= now() and upv.primary_flag is true and (upv.end_date is null or upv.end_date >= now()) and not exists (select pczu.user_id from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu where postal_code_zone_id = :zoneId and pczu.user_id = upv.user_id and case when :loadSchedulers is true then pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id = 2 else pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id = 1 end and archived is not true) order by full_name
sql.postalCode.getAllZoneUsers: select pczu.user_id as id, pczu.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS title, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(positions))) FROM ( SELECT up.id, up.user_id as "userId", up.id as "userPositionId", p.position, p.schedulable, p.scheduler, up.position_id as "positionId", up.org_id as "orgId", o.company_state_id as "companyStateId", up.start_date as "startDate", up.end_date as "endDate", up.primary_flag as "primaryFlag", up.archived, (select json_agg(json_build_object( 'orgId', h.org_id, 'orgName', h.org_name, 'positionLevel', h.position_level, 'orgLevelId', h.org_level_id ) order by h.org_level_id)::jsonb from flow.user_org_hierarchy(up.org_id) as h) as "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = up.org_id WHERE up.user_id = pczu.user_id and up.archived is not true) positions), '[]') AS "userPositions" from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow.postal_code_zone pcz on pcz.id = pczu.postal_code_zone_id inner join flow."user" u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.archived is not true and pcz.company_id = :companyId and pczu.postal_code_zone_user_type_id = 1 and ((cast(:zoneIds as int[]) is null) OR pczu.postal_code_zone_id = any (:zoneIds)) order by full_name
sql.postalCode.checkForExisting: select pc.id, pc.postal_code_zone_id, pc.postal_code, pc.archived, pcz.archived as postal_code_zone_archived from flow.postal_code pc inner join flow.postal_code_zone pcz on pc.postal_code_zone_id = pcz.id where pc.postal_code = :postalCode and pc.archived is not true
